text: dsh-chat-enhancer 是面向 DSH Web 的对话界面插件，会识别 Mermaid 代码块并在消息中渲染为 SVG 图表。页面内新增打开预览、滚轮缩放、拖拽平移、适应窗口和原始比例查看等交互，并可根据 DSH 深浅主题重新渲染。适合在查看流程图、时序图等 Mermaid 内容时需要放大或浏览大图的用户。安装命令为 dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-chat-enhancer；代码未配置 API Key 或外部服务。

dsh-chat-enhancer renders Mermaid code blocks as diagrams in DSH Web. Open a diagram in a preview to zoom, pan, fit it to the window, or view it at 100%. Keyboard shortcuts control the preview, which rerenders when the DSH theme changes. Install with dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-chat-enhancer.
想让 DSH 对话里的 Mermaid 图表直接显示成图。
DSH Web 能不能把消息中的 Mermaid 流程图放大查看？
I want to zoom and pan around large Mermaid diagrams in my DSH conversations.
dsh-chat-enhancer 的功能「Mermaid 图表渲染」：自动识别 Mermaid 语言标记或图表语法的代码块，并在对话中渲染为 SVG；渲染失败时保留原始代码块。
dsh-chat-enhancer 的功能「图表预览与导航」：点击打开按钮进入独立预览窗口，可滚轮缩放、拖拽平移、适应窗口或按 100% 查看，也支持键盘缩放与关闭。

A focused conversation enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web.

dsh-chat-enhancer README · Features：Version 0.2 focuses on Mermaid code blocks in conversations:

- Renders `mermaid`, `mermaidjs`, and `mmd` fenced blocks as SVG
- Opens diagrams in a centered preview window instead of browser fullscreen
- Provides smooth pointer-centered mouse-wheel zooming inside the preview
- Supports click-and-drag panning, fit-to-window, 100%, and keyboard shortcuts
- Re-renders when the DSH light or dark theme changes
- Uses Mermaid `securityLevel: strict` and falls back to source on render errors

dsh-chat-enhancer README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-chat-enhancer
```

Restart DSH Web after installing, upgrading, or removing the plugin.

To install a local checkout for development:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Tieboyh/dsh-chat-enhancer.git
cd dsh-chat-enhancer
npm install
npm run check

dsh-chat-enhancer README · Usage：Ask the model to return a Mermaid fence:

````markdown
```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[开始] --> B[完成]
```
````

Use **Open** on a rendered diagram to enter the preview window. Scroll to zoom around the pointer, drag to pan, press `+`/`-` to zoom, press `0` to fit, or press `Esc` to close.

DeepSeek Harness Web 的轻量对话体验增强插件。

dsh-chat-enhancer README · 功能：0.2 版只增强会话中的 Mermaid 代码块：

- 自动把 `mermaid`、`mermaidjs`、`mmd` 围栏渲染为 SVG
- 在居中的预览窗口查看，不调用浏览器全屏
- 只在预览窗口内启用以鼠标位置为中心的连续滚轮缩放
- 支持拖拽平移、适应窗口、100% 和键盘快捷键
- 跟随 DSH 深浅主题重新渲染
- 使用 Mermaid `securityLevel: strict`，渲染失败时自动回退源码

dsh-chat-enhancer README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-chat-enhancer
```

安装、升级或卸载后需要重启 DSH Web。

如需安装本地源码用于开发：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Tieboyh/dsh-chat-enhancer.git
cd dsh-chat-enhancer
npm install
npm run check

dsh-chat-enhancer README · 使用：让模型输出 Mermaid 围栏：

````markdown
```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[开始] --> B[完成]
```
````

点击图表上的“打开”进入预览窗口。滚轮可围绕鼠标位置缩放，拖拽可平移；也可以按 `+`/`-` 缩放、按 `0` 适应窗口、按 `Esc` 关闭。
